name: Cupboard
dimensions: Height 263 cm; Length 157 cm; Depth 62.5 cm
summary: Massive cupboard of plain polished huanghuali wood with brass fittings. It has a detached upper section, 4-panel fronts on both upper and lower sections, and is set on square legs with decorated curvilinear aprons. It was used for storing clothes.
